title: Simultaneous lifts of generated abelian sections at prescribed stage objects
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ be precoverages [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] whose transition functors are continuous, let $V$ be a cocone with colimiting object and arrow set cocones [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor], and let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ for which all cocone functors are continuous. Fix $i\in J$, an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$, and morphisms $\alpha_t:F(t.hom)^{-1}G\to V_t^*(V_i^{-1}G)$ for $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ whose composites with the stage units equal the $V_i$ unit componentwise as arrows. Let $B$ be the explicitly generated stage-image abelian subpresheaf [def-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-stage-image]. For $t_0\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, a finite type $\kappa$, objects $Z_k\in F(t_0.right)$ and sections $x_k\in B(V_{t_0}Z_k)$, there are $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, a morphism $e:t_0\to t$, and sections $y_k\in F(t.hom)^{-1}G(F(e.right)Z_k)$ such that $\alpha_t(y_k)=(V_i^{-1}G)(\mathrm{eqToHom}(h_k))(x_k)$, where $h_k:V_t(F(e.right)Z_k)=V_{t_0}(Z_k)$ is the equality obtained by evaluating cocone naturality on $Z_k$. No cover, cover-preservation, pullback-preservation or section-compatibility hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Construct stage transition morphisms by the proved exists_transition helper of the stage-image refinement module, transposing the composite inverse-image unit through the earlier stage adjunction. The proved sheaf_triangle_comp helper identifies alpha after transition with the earlier alpha, from h-alpha and h-theta. These maps are uniquely determined adjuncts, not arbitrary choices of data.

For one generator restricted from a section stage t to a prescribed object Z at t0, represent its restricting arrow by Types.jointly_surjective_of_isColimit harrows. First take a common object of t0 and t in Under i, then move above this object and the arrow-representative stage in J. The chosen paths define morphisms in Under i from both original stages. Apply Types.FilteredColimit.isColimit_eq_iff' hobjects twice to align the lifted arrow source with the forward image of Z and its target with the forward image of the generator object. Compose the lifted arrow with endpoint eqToHom morphisms. Its cocone image has the same Arrow.mk as the original restriction by V.w and the Arrow transport lemmas. This is the private restriction_at_stage proof.

Transition the generator section along the obtained morphism from t and restrict it along the lifted arrow. Naturality of alpha, its transition equation, and equality of the Arrow.mk images identify the resulting image after cocone-object transport with the prescribed generator. Use the proved arrow_comp_congr helper to combine the two morphism equalities. For any further refinement the same transition equation and naturality preserve this image. In one_section_lift define evaluations over Under t0; the evaluation transition m satisfies m followed by k at the new stage equals k at the old stage, by sheaf_triangle_comp and eqToHom naturality.

Induct on the proof that x belongs to the additive closure of the generators. Use the preceding construction for a generator, zero at the identity refinement for zero, negation for negatives, and move two representatives to IsFiltered.max in Under t0 and add their transitioned sections for a sum. Additivity and the evaluation transition equation prove the image formula. Consequently one section has a representative after some refinement and after every further refinement.

Apply the one-section result to each member of the finite index type. Form the finite set of the chosen refinement objects and use IsFiltered.sup_objs_exists in Under t0. It supplies one object s receiving every chosen refinement, including when the finite set is empty. Choose a representative at s for each index. Take t = s.right and e = s.hom. untransport_section converts the equation obtained after forward object transport to the displayed restriction equation by equality elimination. Empty families impose no choices or equations; zero sections are covered by the closure induction zero case.

theorem colimit_site_abelian_finite_object_section_lift
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (t0 : Under i) {κ : Type u} [Finite κ] (Z : κ → F.obj t0.right)
    (x : ∀ k, (ColimitSiteStageImage.presheaf F P V Q i G α).obj
      (op ((V.ι.app t0.right).toFunctor.obj (Z k)))) :
    ∃ (t : Under i) (e : t0 ⟶ t)
      (y : ∀ k, ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map e.right).toFunctor.obj (Z k)))),
      ∀ k, (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map e.right).toFunctor.obj (Z k))) (y k) =
        (ColimitSiteStageImage.target F P V Q i G).obj.map
          (eqToHom (congrArg (fun H : F.obj t0.right ⟶ V.pt =>
            H.toFunctor.obj (Z k)) (V.w e.right))).op (x k).val
